team.name: Qwen Team
team.positioning: 从开放权重语言模型出发，持续扩展到多模态、智能体、语音、视觉生成与具身智能的公开研究网络。
team.boundary: 本页依据 Qwen 官方研究页、QwenLM GitHub 组织和官方技术报告构建。它描述可核验的公开研究工作集，不代表阿里巴巴内部组织架构、完整成员名录或全部研究成果。

theme.shapeLanguage: large whitespace, rounded cards and pill controls

designReference.notes: Information architecture follows the Awesome Team framework; visual language references the current Qwen research site without copying its marketing content.

directions.name: Foundation Models
directions.label: 基础模型
directions.description: 统一思考与非思考模式，覆盖 Dense 与 MoE 架构，并将多语言能力作为模型底座。

directions.name: Multimodal & Omni
directions.label: 全模态
directions.description: 把文本、图像、音频和视频理解与实时语音生成纳入同一模型系统。

directions.name: Agent & World Models
directions.label: 智能体与世界模型
directions.description: 从代码智能体、浏览器环境到语言世界模型，研究可执行、可规划的通用智能体。

directions.name: Vision & Generation
directions.label: 视觉与生成
directions.description: 视觉语言理解、复杂文字渲染、图像生成与精确编辑共同构成视觉研究主线。

directions.name: Speech & Audio
directions.label: 语音与音频
directions.description: 覆盖流式语音识别、强制对齐、声音克隆、语音设计与低延迟生成。

directions.name: Embodied Intelligence
directions.label: 具身智能
directions.description: 以视觉—语言—动作模型统一操作、导航、轨迹预测和不同机器人形态。

activity.title: qwen-code 持续推送

publications.title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
publications.abstract: A world model predicts environment dynamics from observations and actions. Qwen-AgentWorld introduces language world models that simulate agentic environments across seven domains through long chain-of-thought reasoning, plus AgentWorldBench and two ways to use simulation for agent training.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments
publications.abstract: Qwen-VLA extends Qwen's vision-language stack from perception and reasoning to continuous action generation. It unifies manipulation, navigation and trajectory prediction, while embodiment-aware prompts adapt one model to multiple robot platforms.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen3-Coder-Next Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen3-Coder-Next is an 80-billion-parameter coding-agent model that activates 3 billion parameters during inference. Its training combines large-scale verifiable coding tasks, executable environments, mid-training and reinforcement learning.

publications.title: Qwen3-ASR Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen3-ASR combines all-in-one speech recognition with a non-autoregressive forced alignment model. The family supports language identification and recognition for 52 languages and dialects, plus timestamp prediction.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen3-TTS Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen3-TTS is a multilingual, controllable and streaming speech generation family. It supports three-second voice cloning, description-based voice design and ultra-low-latency generation through specialized speech tokenizers.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen3-VL Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen3-VL supports interleaved text, image and video contexts up to 256K tokens. It strengthens long-context multimodal understanding, spatial-temporal modeling and image-grounded reasoning across dense and MoE variants.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen3-Omni unifies text, image, audio and video in a Thinker–Talker MoE architecture. It targets real-time multimodal interaction, streaming speech and explicit reasoning over inputs from any modality.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen-Image Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen-Image is an image generation foundation model focused on complex text rendering and precise editing. Its training pipeline combines large-scale data curation, progressive curricula and dual semantic/reconstructive image encodings.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen3 Embedding: Advancing Text Embedding and Reranking Through Foundation Models
publications.abstract: The Qwen3 Embedding series builds multilingual embedding and reranking models on Qwen3 backbones. Its training pipeline combines unsupervised pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, model merging and synthetic data generation.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: WorldPM: Scaling Human Preference Modeling
publications.abstract: WorldPM studies scaling behavior in preference modeling with 15 million preference examples and models from 1.5B to 72B parameters. It separates adversarial, objective and subjective preference metrics and evaluates transfer to RLHF.

attribution.label: 官方研究仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Parallel Scaling Law for Language Models
publications.abstract: ParScale proposes parallel computation as a third scaling axis beside parameters and inference-time tokens. Learnable input transformations and parallel forward passes aim to improve capability with lower memory and latency growth.

attribution.label: 官方研究仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen3 integrates thinking and non-thinking modes in one family of dense and MoE language models. It introduces controllable thinking budgets, knowledge transfer from flagship models and support for 119 languages and dialects.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: PolyMath: Evaluating Mathematical Reasoning in Multilingual Contexts
publications.abstract: PolyMath evaluates multilingual mathematical reasoning across 18 languages and four difficulty levels. It exposes variation in reasoning quality, output-language consistency and thinking length across languages.

attribution.label: 官方研究仓库 + 论文

publications.title: Qwen2.5-Omni Technical Report
publications.abstract: Qwen2.5-Omni is an end-to-end model for text, image, audio and video input with simultaneous text and streaming speech output. Its Thinker–Talker architecture separates reasoning and speech-token generation.

attribution.label: 官方团队仓库 + 论文

publications.title: ProcessBench: Identifying Process Errors in Mathematical Reasoning
publications.abstract: ProcessBench measures whether models can identify the earliest erroneous step in mathematical reasoning. Its 3,400 expert-annotated cases compare process reward models with critic-style language models.

attribution.label: 官方研究仓库 + 论文
